flow: 1. VALUE: Provide clear service definition, eligibility, or problem insights first.
2. UNDERSTANDING: Collect industry context (e.g. Manufacturing vs Service, OEM supplier, wastage type).
3. RECOMMENDATION: Offer tailored advice (e.g. ISO 9001 baseline + IATF 16949 for automotive).
4. CONSULTATION / QUOTATION: Offer free expert consultation call or customized quotation proposal.
5. LEAD CAPTURE: Collect contact details progressively and naturally without being intrusive.

criteria: Requested immediate on-site consultation or audit readiness check
Has urgent tender deadline or buyer audit scheduled
Provided complete contact details (Name, Company, Mobile)
Seriously evaluating ISO/ZED/Lean options for company expansion
Asking detailed implementation steps, timelines, and document requirements
Student research or basic generic questions
Incomplete answers without immediate business context
